title: Licensing Flu Shot Study
brief_summary: The mailer will encourage all employees of one of Evive's partner companies to attend an on-site free flu shot clinic they are offering in the fall of 2011. The research will examine differences in follow-through on getting a flu shot at an on-site clinic among the targeted population during the \~1 month period when clinics are being offered (following the mailing) as a function of experimental condition.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Employee at partner corporation

Exclusion Criteria:

* Employee already received a flu shot this season
